title: viola odorata f. albiflora
intro: Viola odorata f. albiflora, commonly known as White Fragrant Violet, is a fragrant, flowering plant that belongs to the Violaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of White Fragrant Violet include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and ease muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
